result.reason: The clause still contains no aggregate liability cap, so it fails both the preferred cap and the fallback 12-month-fees cap. Although it retains a mutual consequential-damages exclusion and adds some carve-outs, the data carve-out appears specific to Sparkling rather than mutual, and required indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs are not clearly identified unless Sections 13 and 14 happen to cover them. It also adds death, personal injury, property damage, equitable relief, and specified express-remedy provisions that are not required by the playbook and may materially expand liability or remedies. The drafting is generally readable but does not implement the core commercial position.
